scenarios.name: fxpic_20_psochk
scenarios.subject: Toad Town mac_01 at 0 0 200, fxtest=20 (explosion), cold det start with the psochk switch: the entry-form draw of the explosion pilot (explosion.c:229, pe_explosion_0) is compared with the walker description (psochk f<frame> draws <n> bad <n> lines).

scenarios.debug: warp=mac_01:0 pos=0:0:200 fxtest=20 loglevel=debug det psochk
